R5C-grouse-atv-0001.name: 280 m E of Homathko River
R5C-grouse-atv-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R5C-grouse-atv-0001.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
2 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: sooty (blue), ruffed and spruce: 10 (30) in aggregate
No row in the Region 2 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from Chilanko Forks, about 153 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.22067, -124.98745, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 570 m to the start. Ride: the unnamed road stretch, 3.9 km one way. About 77 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 2-15, Region 2. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-15, closures 2026-10-16.
R5C-grouse-atv-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 2-15: about 212 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.06 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.6 km and about 25 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
